name: gauge
description: A partial-arc gauge with a configurable opening gap, similar to a speedometer. Best suited for CPU and GPU usage monitoring.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in the gauge

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: Override the maximum value for the gauge. If not set, the max is automatically determined from the metric

config.name: open_angle_percent
config.label: Opening Gap in %
config.description: Controls how much of the bottom of the gauge is open. 0% creates a full circle, higher values create a wider opening

config.name: thickness
config.label: Thickness
config.description: The width of the gauge arc in pixels

config.name: corner_radius
config.label: Corner Radius
config.description: Rounds the ends of the gauge arc. Set to 0 for flat edges

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the gauge arc

config.name: back_color
config.label: Back Color
config.description: The background color of the unfilled portion of the gauge

config.name: hide_thresholds
config.label: Hide Thresholds
config.description: Hides the outer threshold ring that shows normal, warning, and critical zones

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the gauge switches to the warning color

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The gauge color when the warning threshold is exceeded

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the gauge switches to the critical color

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The gauge color when the critical threshold is exceeded
